# 4 bedroom detached house for sale

> The Ellen is a stylish and characterful 4-bedroom detached home with a garage and Plot 65 is a corner plot. The hub of this home is the spacious open plan kitchen/dining area which comprises a modern breakfast bar, fully integrated kitchen with quality appliances, and stylish French doors that open out to the patio and rear garden, perfect for warmer days. There's also a useful utility room.
